name: XX_champion aura dread spheres invis anchor
comment: What a Shadow champion's Dread Spheres aura spawns (SpawnMonster JIMV, 579610 / 636113) at a random point near a player: the invisible centre the spheres circle (636118 / 579609 cast on it: the warning orbs, then the orb wrapper every 2 s, 10 s orbs). The template (TDB 51000 #2505) matches the hash by name only; the invisible look as other anchors, level and health, and a lifetime of the first pulse plus the orbs' 10 s are guesses.
